title: Auto Mode and Prediction
mission: Predict each repair before it happens
briefing: The vault has learned to repair itself. Before each delivery arrives, predict which repair the insert will trigger: None, LL, RR, LR or RL. Then watch the vault twist itself back into shape. A wrong prediction jolts the alarm.
hints: Imagine the insert path, then find the first room whose balance factor would reach 2 or -2.
Heavy child leaning the same way: single rotation. Leaning the other way: double rotation.
